plain: During the 1976 night when jets of the Shah's Iranian air force reportedly chased an unknown object over Tehran, a US early-warning satellite of the Defense Support Program, which watches for heat from missile launches, is said to have recorded an infrared anomaly. A researcher named Maaneli Derakhshani tells Michels that the aerospace researchers Lee Graham and Ron Regehr claimed to have examined the satellite's printouts for the exact day and time of the chase, which, if so, would back the pilots' story with machine data.
